name: @fitloop/web
description: FitLoop web app + Worker: Google sign-in, today's plan and check-ins, plan versions, progress, feedback for your agent, settings, glasses pairing, the API for the iPhone app and the glasses plugin, and the MCP server for your agent with its OAuth endpoints (Cloudflare)

scripts.dev:worker: VITE_EMAIL_SIGNIN=1 vite build --mode development && wrangler dev
scripts.upload-version: vite build && wrangler versions upload --env production
